# Airline Pilot Forums

> A comprehensive community forum for airline pilots, aviation professionals, and career-minded aviators to discuss careers, hiring, training, and industry developments.

Airline Pilot Forums (APC) is the central hub for pilot community discussions covering major carriers, regional airlines, cargo operations, military transitions, and all segments of aviation employment. The site aggregates hiring news, career guidance, technical discussions, and union-related topics relevant to professional aviators.

## Key Topics

- Airline careers
- Pilot hiring
- Career development
- Regional airlines
- Major carriers
- Part 121 operations
- Flight training
- Labor relations
- Union discussions
- Interview preparation
- Military transitions
- Cargo operations
- Fractional ownership
- Technical flying
- Aviation community

## Airline Career Forums

- [Airline Pilot Forums](https://www.airlinepilotforums.com/airline-pilot-forums): Main airline pilot forums with discussions on careers, unions, interviews
- [Major Carriers](https://www.airlinepilotforums.com/major): Forum for legacy, national, and LCC major carrier pilot discussions
- [Regional Airlines](https://www.airlinepilotforums.com/regional): Forum for regional airline pilot community and job discussions
- [Cargo Airlines](https://www.airlinepilotforums.com/cargo): Forum for Part 121 cargo airline pilots including FedEx and Atlas
- [Charter Operations](https://www.airlinepilotforums.com/charter): Forum for Part 121 passenger charter airline pilot discussions
- [Foreign Airlines](https://www.airlinepilotforums.com/foreign): Forum for foreign airlines hiring U.S. pilots internationally

## Career Development & Training

- [Career Builder](https://www.airlinepilotforums.com/career-builder): Forum for pilot career development, training, and ratings guidance
- [Career Questions](https://www.airlinepilotforums.com/career-questions): Forum for career advice, interview prep, gouges, and job fairs
- [Flight Schools and Training](https://www.airlinepilotforums.com/flight-schools-training): Forum for flight schools, ratings, hours building, and CFI topics
- [Military Aviation](https://www.airlinepilotforums.com/military): Forum for military aviation pilots and career transition discussions

## Alternative Aviation Sectors

- [Fractional Ownership](https://www.airlinepilotforums.com/fractional): Forum for fractional ownership operators like NetJets and FlexJet
- [Corporate Aviation](https://www.airlinepilotforums.com/corporate): Forum for corporate aviation operators and pilot discussions
- [Part 135 Operations](https://www.airlinepilotforums.com/part-135): Forum for Part 135 commercial operator pilot discussions
- [Part 91 and Low Time](https://www.airlinepilotforums.com/part-91-low-time): Forum for Part 91 jobs including jump pilots and crop dusting

## Industry News & Labor Relations

- [Hiring News](https://www.airlinepilotforums.com/hiring-news): Forum for latest airline hiring news, rumors, and industry updates
- [Union Talk](https://www.airlinepilotforums.com/union-talk): Forum for macro-level union, legislation, and organizing discussions

## Technical & Professional Resources

- [Technical Flying](https://www.airlinepilotforums.com/technical): Forum for technical flying aspects and airline operations discussions
- [Engineers & Technicians](https://www.airlinepilotforums.com/engineers-technicians): Forum for aeronautical engineers and aircraft maintenance discussions

## Community

- [Pilot Lounge](https://www.airlinepilotforums.com/pilot-lounge): General hangar talk forum for off-topic pilot community discussions
- [Homepage](https://www.airlinepilotforums.com): Airline Pilot Central Forums homepage for active and future pilots
